recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core follow-up is needed unless the Extension Pack later drops localization wording or core stops linking the translation extension from the multi-language/localization page.
issue_request: FHIR-12457 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request from DSTU2 asking that the standard translation extension page include localize/localization wording so searches for localization would find it. The accepted resolution was to add the word as an alias.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 11177, preserved as git commit 448416f7fcdde213e0398ce40da1377337ebe883 (#12457 - add "Localization"), which added Localization as the alias and changed the old core translation extension short text to Language Translation (Localization).
additional_context: The translation extension later moved out of core with the R5 extension-pack split; commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed the old core rows. The current Extension Pack source for StructureDefinition/translation still says Language Translation (Localization), and the active core languages page is titled Multi-Language support in FHIR (Localization/Internationalization) and links to the translation extension. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting FHIR-12457 history.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current core build already has a localization entry point and the authoritative current translation extension definition is in the Extension Pack with the requested localization wording.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue requesting localize/localization wording on the standard translation extension page; resolution was to add the word as an alias.
evidence_items.learned: The accepted change was a discoverability alias for the translation extension, not a substantive behavior change.

evidence_items.summary: Commit #12457 - add "Localization" added the alias and the short text Language Translation (Localization) to the old core general extensions spreadsheet.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-12457 was explicitly applied in the historical core source.

evidence_items.summary: Commit remove extensions from R5 source removed the old core translation extension rows from source/profiles/general-extensions-spreadsheet.xml.
evidence_items.learned: The current core source omission is explained by the extension-pack move rather than by an unapplied alias.

evidence_items.summary: The current Extension Pack translation extension definition has short text Language Translation (Localization).
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative current extension definition retains the localization wording requested by the issue.

evidence_items.summary: The active core Multi-Language Support page is titled with Localization/Internationalization and links to the translation extension.
evidence_items.learned: Core has a build-scoped localization entry point without needing to duplicate extension-pack metadata.

evidence_items.command: curl -fsSL https://build.fhir.org/languages.html | rg -n -i 'Localization|Translation Extension|StructureDefinition-translation'; curl -fsSL https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/fhir-extensions/StructureDefinition-translation.html | rg -n -i 'Language Translation|Localization'
evidence_items.summary: The rendered core page includes Localization/Internationalization and links to the rendered Extension Pack page, which shows Language Translation (Localization).
evidence_items.learned: The current publication surface matches the source-level no-change conclusion.
